description: Novartis AG is a Swiss multinational pharmaceutical corporation engaged in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of pharmaceuticals, vaccines, generic drugs, contact lenses, diagnostics, animal health products, over-the-counter drugs, and veterinary medicine. The company operates in 118 countries and serves a global patient base, with a focus on therapeutic areas such as cardiovascular, renal and metabolic, immunology, neuroscience, and oncology. Novartis also engages in research and development, including gene therapies, radioligand therapy, and RNA therapies, and is involved in biotechnology and eyewear. The company is publicly traded and is committed to sustainability and ethical business practices.

Acino International AG is a Swiss pharmaceutical company engaged in the development, manufacturing, and international marketing of pharmaceuticals, including prescription medicines, over-the-counter products, and food supplements. The company operates in therapeutic areas such as aesthetics, allergology, cardiovascular diseases, and women’s health, and provides contract manufacturing and out-licensing services to pharmaceutical companies. Acino also offers pharmacovigilance services and is certified in EU GMP and B-BBEE. The company serves clients in over 90 countries, with a presence in the Middle East, Turkey, Africa, Ukraine, Eurasian countries, and Latin America.

Sumitomo Pharma Switzerland GmbH is a Swiss pharmaceutical company engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of pharmaceutical products, with a focus on oncology, urology, women’s health, rare diseases, cell and gene therapies, and central nervous system disorders. The company also conducts research and development activities, including drug discovery and product development, and is involved in co-promotion agreements. Sumitomo Pharma Switzerland serves markets in the U.S., Canada, and Europe, and is part of a global network of subsidiaries and affiliates supporting its operations in these regions.

MSD Merck Sharp & Dohme AG is a Swiss biopharmaceutical company engaged in the research, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of medicines and vaccines. The company operates in multiple therapeutic areas, including oncology, infectious diseases, immunology, cardio-metabolic disorders, and vaccines. MSD also provides analytical methods for new active substances and medicines, and manages a supply chain and logistics network for global distribution. The company is certified and participates in clinical trials and research activities.

IBSA Institut Biochimique SA is a Swiss pharmaceutical company engaged in the production of therapeutic products, including prescription drugs, over-the-counter medicines, medical devices, and food supplements. The company serves healthcare professionals and the pharmaceutical industry globally, with a focus on areas such as reproductive medicine, endocrinology, pain and inflammation, osteoarticular diseases, aesthetic medicine, dermatology, uro-gynaecology, cardiometabolic diseases, and respiratory diseases. IBSA also engages in licensing activities and international distribution, and is committed to sustainability through its operations and product development.

Tillotts Pharma AG is a Swiss pharmaceutical company engaged in the development, in/out-licensing, and marketing of pharmaceutical products for gastroenterology, with a focus on inflammatory bowel diseases. The company also operates as a contract manufacturer and conducts research and development in controlled release technologies. Tillotts Pharma serves global markets through affiliates and strategic partnerships, and is part of the Japanese Zeria Group.

CRISPR Therapeutics AG is a Swiss-American biotechnology company engaged in gene editing technologies and gene-based medicines. The company develops therapies for a range of diseases, including hemoglobinopathies, immuno-oncology, autoimmune diseases, in vivo gene editing, and regenerative medicine. CRISPR Therapeutics operates globally, with offices in Switzerland, the United States, and the United Kingdom, and maintains a manufacturing facility in the United States. The company also engages in strategic partnerships to advance its research and development activities.
core_offerings: Allogeneic CAR T Cell Therapy Development
Patient Advocacy and Community Engagement Services
In Vivo Gene Editing Therapy Development
Sustainability and Corporate Social Responsibility Services

primary_naics.label: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)

description: PSI CRO AG is a Swiss contract research organization that provides clinical research services, including clinical trial planning, execution, and site support for pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies. The company operates globally, with offices in multiple countries, and offers services in areas such as precision medicine, complex clinical trials, and pharmaceutical manufacturing. PSI CRO also develops proprietary tools for clinical trial feasibility assessment and planning.

Idorsia Pharmaceuticals Ltd is a Swiss biopharmaceutical company engaged in the discovery, development, and commercialization of small molecule therapeutics. The company operates in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sectors, with activities including research and development, medical and pharmaceutical manufacturing, and the commercialization of pharmaceutical products. Idorsia serves global markets through subsidiaries in multiple countries and is publicly traded on the Swiss stock exchange.

Helsinn Healthcare SA is a Swiss pharmaceutical company engaged in the research, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and nutritional supplements. The company operates in oncology, rare diseases, and supportive care, and manages a global portfolio of products approved in multiple countries. Helsinn also provides licensing services, including in-licensing, partnering, and business development, and maintains a pharmacovigilance system for adverse event monitoring. The company is certified for sustainability and ethical standards, and its operations are supported by a hybrid manufacturing approach and a global presence with offices in Ireland, the United States, and China.

Debiopharm International SA is a Swiss biopharmaceutical company engaged in drug development, manufacturing, and digital health investment. The company operates as a Life Science division within Après-demain SA, managing research and development, clinical testing, and the commercialization of prescription drugs for oncology and bacterial infections. Debiopharm also invests in digital health and smart data start-ups, and is involved in the development of antibody-drug conjugates, antibiotic-resistant infections, DNA-damage response inhibition, and radioligand therapy. The company is certified and collaborates with partners and organizations to support its operations.
core_offerings: Patient Quality of Life Improvement Solutions

description: Ferring International Center S.A. is a Swiss biopharmaceutical company engaged in the research, development, and manufacturing of pharmaceutical products and therapies for reproductive medicine, maternal health, gastroenterology, urology, and microbiome research. The company also operates as a pharmaceutical manufacturer and provides clinical research services. Ferring serves markets in over 100 countries and maintains a global presence with offices and manufacturing sites in Europe, the United States, Asia, and South America.

Octapharma AG is a Swiss pharmaceutical company engaged in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of human protein-based therapies. The company operates research and development, manufacturing, and plasma donation center facilities, and manages a global supply chain and logistics network to support its international operations. Octapharma serves patients in 120 countries, with a focus on therapeutic areas such as haematology, immunotherapy, and critical care.
core_offerings: Coagulopathy and Bleeding Disorder Medicine Manufacturing

description: Galderma S.A. is a Swiss pharmaceutical company engaged in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of dermatological treatments and skin care products. The company operates in the dermatology and pharmaceutical sectors, providing injectable aesthetics, dermatological skincare, and therapeutic dermatology solutions. Galderma serves healthcare professionals and consumers globally, with operations in multiple countries and a network of subsidiaries and affiliates. The company is publicly traded on the SIX Swiss Exchange.

CARBOGEN AMCIS AG, DBA CARBOGEN AMCIS, is a Swiss pharmaceutical company that operates as a Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) for the pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical sectors. The company provides contract chemical process research and development, API supply, drug product development, and contract research and manufacturing services. It also offers specialized services such as process research, high-potency API manufacturing, clean room facilities for antibody drug conjugates, and chromatography services. CARBOGEN AMCIS serves clients globally from multiple sites in Europe and Asia.
core_offerings: Cholesterol and Vitamin D Analog Manufacturing

description: Corden Pharma International GmbH, DBA CordenPharma, is a Swiss contract development and manufacturing organization specialized in the development and manufacturing of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), lipid excipients, drug products, injectables, peptides, oligonucleotides, and small molecules. The company serves pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies worldwide, providing contract manufacturing services for APIs, drug products, and lipid excipients. CordenPharma operates a global network of cGMP facilities across Europe and North America, and is certified to GMP standards. The company also develops technologies for the commercialization of highly potent medicines and is involved in the research and development of nanomedicines and other complex pharmaceutical modalities.
core_offerings: Solid Form and Polymorphism Technology Application

description: Lonza Group Ltd is a Swiss contract development and manufacturing organization that provides integrated solutions for the healthcare industry, including biologics, small molecules, and specialized modalities. The company operates across three business platforms—Integrated Biologics, Advanced Synthesis, and Specialized Modalities—offering services such as custom manufacturing, product development, and detection systems for the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sectors. Lonza serves clients in Europe, North America, and Asia, and is publicly traded on the SIX Swiss Exchange and the SGX Singapore Exchange.

Bachem AG is a Swiss pharmaceutical company engaged in the development and manufacturing of peptides and oligonucleotides. The company provides products and services for research, clinical development, and commercial applications, including the production of biologically active peptides, amino acid derivatives, and biochemicals. Bachem also offers CMC development, peptide and oligonucleotide new chemical entity development, commercial API manufacturing, custom peptide synthesis, research-grade production, diagnostics, and cosmetics. The company operates internationally, with facilities in Switzerland, the United States, and Asia, and is certified for GMP compliance.

A. Menarini GmbH is a Swiss pharmaceutical company engaged in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of medicinal products for primary and specialty care, with a focus on cardiovascular diseases, pain management, infectiology, allergology, and urology. The company also operates in medical aesthetics and provides laboratory services. A. Menarini serves both general practitioners and specialists, and is part of a global network with a presence in 140 countries.

TRB CHEMEDICA INTERNATIONAL SA, DBA TRB Chemedica, is a Swiss pharmaceutical company engaged in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of hyaluronic acid-based medical devices, medical food supplements, and pharmaceutical products. The company operates a Swiss manufacturing facility and maintains subsidiaries and distributors in multiple countries across Asia, South America, Europe, and the United Kingdom. TRB Chemedica is ISO certified and is active in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device sectors, with a focus on ophthalmology, rheumatology, and neurology.
